title: Rental Expense Counted in the Damages for Deductible Refunds
content:
**Rule.** Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), a rental part is added to the damages a refund is shared over. It is read from the vehicle's Rental Reimbursement Coverage on the claim number:
- **Rental benefits paid.** When rental benefits were paid on the claim, the rental part is the benefits paid, less those reversed, plus the rental days not yet invoiced at the authorised daily rate. Those days run from the day after the last day of the latest paid invoice period to the end of the rental, the end not counted.
- **Rental authorised, nothing paid.** When no benefit has been paid but a rental was authorised on the claim, the rental part is the authorised daily rate multiplied by the rental days from the authorised start date to the end of the rental. The start date is counted and the end is not. There are no days when the rental ends on or before its start date.
- **No rental authorised.** When no rental was authorised on the claim, the rental part is nothing.

**Which authorisation, and when the rental ends.**
- The rental authorised on the claim is the authorisation with the latest entry date. The claim number and entry date identify one authorisation, so no two share a date. Its rate and start date are read from that authorisation.
- The rental ends on the claim's latest closing entry when that closing is dated on or after that authorisation's entry date. Otherwise the rental runs to today, since a closing dated before the authorisation belongs to an earlier authorisation.

### Worked cases on hypothetical Rental Reimbursement Coverage entries

- **Benefits paid.** 420.00 USD paid and 35.00 USD reversed; the latest paid invoice period ends on the 10th; the authorised rate is 35.00 USD; the rental closed on the 15th. The days not yet invoiced are the 11th through the 14th, which is 4 days. The rental part is 420.00 less 35.00, plus 4 multiplied by 35.00, which is 525.00 USD.
- **Authorised, nothing paid.** A 40.00 USD rate from a start date of the 5th, with a closing entered on the 12th on or after the authorisation's entry date. The days are the 5th through the 11th, which is 7 days, so the rental part is 280.00 USD.
- **Closing before the start date.** The same authorisation is closed on the 4th, on or after its entry date but before the 5th start date. There are no rental days, so the rental part is zero.
- **No authorisation on the claim.** Nothing is added.
